items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: But they had a fellow there named Jazz Richardson. He was a mighty great comedian at the time

ctx.x: But Hosey Sapp had the band when I was on that. And Hosey Sapp has caused me being on, uh, on, uh, uh, Brown Skin Marvel. About stuff

When they were trying to find a comedian, I happened to be in New Orleans at the time at the palace. I stayed there seven weeks at the palace doing a single. And they couldn't find nobody to hold down the spot. But they had a fellow there named Jazz Richardson. He was a mighty great comedian at the time, but somehow, I don't know where they let him go, I think. I don't know where they didn't do something right or something wrong, anyhow, they let him go. I said, well, they came to New Orleans and were looking for…
